sections.title: Arsenal
sections.html:
Arsenal Women

Arsenal went ahead through Frida Maanum in the 22nd minute, but Caroline Graham Hansen levelled for Barcelona in the 59th, set up by Esmee Brugts, and it finished 1–1. Arsenal Women have won 3 and drawn 2 of their last five, unbeaten in 6.

  • Fri 20 Nov, 4am · OL Lyonnes (home) · UEFA Women's Champions League
